finding: Weight (kg) uses a colloquial label for mass.
handling: Questions distinguish kg mass, N force and N·m torque without changing source numbers.

finding: Plot axis says Motor Torque (Newtons) while text correctly uses Newton-metres.
handling: Use N·m, explicitly disclose the plotted unit omission when the axis is tested.

finding: The absolute claim that a model can always memorize training perfectly is false.
handling: Use a direct counterexample from the printed affine model; representative held-out performance remains the evaluation goal.

finding: Iteration count is listed without algorithm-dependent qualifications.
handling: State risk rather than universal guarantee; do not invent epochs for the least-squares example.

finding: Gaussian synthetic Wi-Fi values are not constrained to [0,100]; ± annotations are standard deviations, not hard limits.
handling: Explicitly treat this as a toy sensor distribution; preserve printed data and plot, including values above 100%.

finding: KMeans call does not pin n_init or init, and raw °C/% coordinates are used without scaling.
handling: Record installed versions/defaults for author runs; avoid universal label-number or cross-version reproducibility promises; state raw-coordinate metric when computing distances.

finding: Action is conflated with action set; reward timing is restricted to after sequences; environment is parenthetically called physical world.
handling: Use explicit per-question qualification and conflict binding for each challenged phrase; preserve the source’s cumulative-reward and agent-interaction ideas.
